safePurpose: Explain how the user's own repeat adult height and weight readings affect the displayed BMI number.
privacy: All measurements and measurement-condition answers remain in the current browser page and must not be stored or transmitted.
disallowed: Presenting observed reading spread as device accuracy, a confidence interval or a clinical tolerance
Setting a target weight, diet, medicine or treatment plan
Applying the adult workflow to children, teenagers or pregnancy
staticText: BMI Measurement Quality Worksheet for /health/bmi-calculator/. Explain adult BMI as kilograms divided by metres squared and describe only the observed spread from the repeat height and weight readings the user entered. The centre uses mean entered height and weight; the interval uses the minimum entered weight with maximum entered height and the maximum entered weight with minimum entered height. It is not a device tolerance, statistical confidence interval or health-risk range. Measurement conditions affect whether spread can be treated as repeatability. Do not diagnose obesity or health, set a target weight, apply adult bands to children, teenagers or pregnancy, or recommend diets, medicines or treatment. Height and weight are sensitive and local: do not request identifiers, store, log, upload, sync, email, add to URLs or send them to analytics. Sources reviewed 2026-07-26: CDC BMI Frequently Asked Questions, WHO STEPS physical-measurement instrument and WHO Obesity and Overweight fact sheet.
